name: Marketing Campaign
publication_holds: Absence-of-external-review hold: one Claude Sonnet and one Grok attempt for WM-ECO-027 each timed out after 120 seconds; no external result was admitted.
Relation hold: WM-ACT-028 is only a provisional parent signal and the frozen relation ledger contains no settled WM-ECO-027 edge.
Identity hold: marketing campaign, revision, wave, flight, activity, placement, communication and interaction remain distinct.
Audience hold: population, segment definition, selected audience, reached party, respondent, lead, opportunity and customer remain distinct and source qualified.
Methodology hold: objectives, KPIs, denominators, attribution, identity resolution, deduplication, experiments, incrementality and optimization require organization and channel validation.
Causality hold: attribution is model-relative and a causal claim requires explicit design, assignment, control, contamination and uncertainty evidence.
Privacy hold: purpose, lawful basis, consent, preference, objection, suppression and channel permission remain separate and jurisdiction scoped.
Bias and targeting hold: audience sources and models require minimisation, recency, provenance, fairness, explanation, prohibited-attribute and protected-group controls.
Financial hold: planned, approved, allocated, committed, incurred and actual budget or cost remain separate from contract, invoice, payment and ledger masters.
Source-access hold: several TM Forum pages were verified through official indexed content while direct automated access was publisher-blocked; TMF699 version labelling is inconsistent.
Profile hold: digital advertising, direct marketing, events, retail, advocacy, fundraising, political, recruitment, business and regulated-sector campaigns need separate profiles.
Interoperability hold: every TM Forum, IAB, Schema.org, privacy, RFC, PROV, DQV, ODRL and OpenAPI projection needs release pins, conformance evidence and loss declarations.
Independent external review was explicitly waived by the repository owner; this codex-only result remains a reviewable draft.
